curatedMovie.curiosityHook: As Pepa tries to regain her balance after being cast aside, the chaos around her refuses to slow down—pulling an entire circle of tangled lives into the spiral.
curatedMovie.description: Dumped unexpectedly by her lover, Pepa watches her everyday life unravel into escalating comedic pandemonium as the lives of everyone connected to her collide in Pedro Almodóvar’s spirited Spanish farce.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Fast-paced, emotionally lively, and playfully chaotic, balancing romantic frustration with breezy comic momentum.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Clocking in at a brisk 88 minutes, this sharp comedy-drama matches high romantic angst with lively, kinetic energy for an effortlessly fun, character-driven watch.

facts.title: Women on the Verge of a Nervous Breakdown
